integrity: The universal frontier is proved analytically from the degree-one Ritz interpolation polynomial and a mean-value bound. Sharpness uses a three-point diagonal spectrum and continuity under a strictly positive perturbation of the starting vector. The embedded checker replays a concrete three-dimensional witness but is not used as an exhaustive proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies exact-arithmetic two-step Lanczos exponential propagation for real diagonal SPD matrices and nonnegative starting vectors. It does not classify higher Krylov dimensions, nonsymmetric Arnoldi, rational or restarted Krylov methods, finite-precision effects, or general non-diagonal positive semigroups.
title: One is the sharp spectral-width positivity frontier for two-step Lanczos exponential propagation
